scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @three-way-match/shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.vercel-build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api
scripts.vercel-build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @three-way-match/shared && npm run typecheck -w @three-way-match/api && npm run typecheck -w @three-way-match/web
